reason: I already cook kra pao and kai jeow without looking anything up, and when I do get stuck I ask my free AI app as many times as I want. Three free questions a day is already more than I would use, so I have no reason to pay for unlimited.
objection: What you are selling is more typing, and typing on my phone with oily hands is exactly the part I hate. 99 baht a month, when the basil pork itself only costs about 50 baht to cook, for two dishes I already know? No.
would_change_my_mind: If I could just ask the chef out loud in Thai while I cook, without touching the phone, I might pay a little for that.
